name: warm-light-suited-man
image_vibe: Confident polished black tailoring, warm yellow studio, understated luxury
image_purpose: Create a professional fashion portrait for menswear lookbook and campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A confident studio portrait of an adult man in a black suit and turtleneck.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult man with a sharp fade haircut and trimmed beard, wearing a black suit and black turtleneck while adjusting amber-tinted glasses. Preserve natural skin texture and a composed confident expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Classic studio portrait framing, solid warm yellow background, glasses adjustment gesture, tailored black silhouette, and clear face/fabric focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused warm studio lighting, gentle facial modeling, subtle amber reflection in the glasses, polished professional fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic high-detail skin, hair, wool, and glasses texture, 8K-style clarity, sharp focus, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a confident photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult man with a sharp fade haircut and trimmed beard, wearing a black suit and black turtleneck while adjusting amber-tinted glasses. Use a solid warm yellow background, soft diffused lighting, gentle facial modeling, subtle amber reflections in the glasses, 85mm lens perspective, shallow depth of field, realistic high-detail skin, hair, wool, and eyewear texture, professional fashion photography, 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, distorted glasses, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, deformed

assets.name: source black-suit portrait reference
assets.usage: Use only for black tailoring, turtleneck, glasses, haircut, yellow background, and lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult man, black suit/turtleneck, amber glasses, fade haircut, trimmed beard, warm yellow background, and 85mm portrait style. Identity and non-essential studio details may vary.
